title: eo discover --json — the parsed platform discovery document
description: Emitted by `eo discover --json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/discover.py): DiscoveryDocument.model_dump() of what the platform served at `{platform}/.well-known/eo-services.json`. This is the PARSED document, not the wire body — unknown top-level keys are dropped by the model, while unknown keys *inside* `services` are preserved verbatim (forward compatibility, SPEC §6.2). The wire format itself is described by schemas/eo-services.schema.json; this schema describes what the CLI prints. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection. `additionalProperties` is true throughout.

version.description: Schema version of the document. The major must match what this eosdk supports, or the whole document is rejected rather than partially parsed.

platform.description: Platform identity block; null when the document carries none, in which case eosdk saves no managed profile snapshot.

name.description: Platform name. Slugified, it is also the config-profile name the SDK snapshots the discovered endpoints under.

services.description: Advertised services, keyed by service name (`catalogue`, `data_access`, `auth`, ...). Deliberately unconstrained: a service or strategy this eosdk does not implement must round-trip through `eo discover --json` untouched rather than be dropped or rejected.
